name: Petal Grid
description: A quiet flower-bed logic puzzle. Plant each kind of petal exactly once in every row and every column. Some petals are already in place. A new bed each day, or as many as you like.
author: Lullshift

help.summary: A square flower bed with a few petals already planted. Each petal kind has a number and a colour: 1 rose, 2 iris, 3 tulip, 4 daisy, and on the larger bed 5 lily and 6 violet.
help.goal: Fill the bed so every row and every column holds each petal kind exactly once. There is always exactly one answer, and no timer.
howToPlay: Move to an empty square and type a number to plant that petal. Planted petals that came with the puzzle are fixed.
If a petal repeats in its row or column, both squares are softly marked and the game says so. Nothing is lost; change either one.
Type 0, Backspace or Delete to clear a square you planted.
Today's bed is the same for everyone today. New bed deals a fresh one. Size switches between 4 by 4 and the larger 6 by 6.
Undo takes back your last change. Clear removes everything you planted.

controls.action: Plant that petal in the focused square
Jump to the start or end of the row
Reach Undo, Clear and the other buttons

tips: Start with a row or column that already has several petals; the missing ones are easy to name.
Look for a square where only one petal kind fits.
You can stop at any time. Your bed is saved and waits for you.
